column1: # maltarun-pins.tsv -- every input `make run` fetches or derives, each pinned.
# Read by tools/maltarun.py, which refuses an input whose size or sha256
# differs.  docs/run.md lists the same rows for a reader; this file owns them.
#   sha256 "manifest": read from the line for this file in the release's
#   source "cut:image": derived from the image, not fetched.
# Provenance of the two Debian pins (2026-10-20): each equals its entry in
# 7,632,456 bytes), whose sha256 is the one buster's Release lists; Release's
# signatures verified with gpgv against debian-archive-keyring 2023.4ubuntu1,
# itself fetched through Ubuntu's signed archive.  docs/run.md, "Prerequisites".
